scope: Selected individually sourced records, not an exhaustive census.

events.title: Courtroom remark sparks controversy
events.summary: The Chief Justice's remarks during a hearing became a viral controversy. His subsequent clarification said his comments concerned people using bogus professional degrees, not young people as a whole.

events.title: Online movement reportedly launched
events.summary: Financial Express retrospectively places the satirical movement's launch on May 16. Earliest original post and account metadata have not been authenticated.

events.title: Original CJP X account reported withheld in India
events.summary: Dipke said the account had been restricted following a legal demand. The underlying platform order and complete account archive have not been reviewed.

events.title: First documented major Jantar Mantar mobilisation
events.summary: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke arrived in Delhi; police granted permission for a demonstration about recruitment and examination irregularities.

events.title: Dipke assaulted at Jaipur demonstration
events.summary: Indian Express reported the founder was assaulted as he entered a protest and five suspects were arrested.

events.title: Parliament march meets barricades and police force
events.summary: Large crowds attempted to move toward Parliament. Police employed batons and tear gas; injuries and clashes were reported.

events.title: Police detail July march injuries and FIRs
events.summary: Police figures and allegations of property damage were reported; these do not independently resolve responsibility for each incident.

events.title: Education minister resigns; agitation withdrawn
events.summary: Dharmendra Pradhan resigned. CJP publicly announced an end to its agitation after government negotiations.

events.title: Sibal publicly announces Rs 1 crore for protester legal aid
events.summary: Kapil Sibal appeared with CJP speakers and announced Rs 1 crore for legal aid to protesters facing FIRs. No payment receipt, beneficiary ledger or completed transfer was independently verified.

events.title: Police affidavit gives 2,873 facial-recognition matches
events.summary: Delhi Police filed a Supreme Court affidavit reporting 2,873 people with apparent criminal-record matches during July protests, describing field verification before action. Underlying match logs and complete affidavit not obtained.

events.title: National Working Committee meeting announced
events.summary: CJP called its committee to review government commitments and possible renewed peaceful agitation. Meeting outcome not verified.

events.title: Supreme Court quashes specified July protest FIRs, records CJP pledge
events.summary: In W.P.(C) 917/2026, the Court used Article 142 to quash specified July FIRs, reserved a narrowly defined 2,873-person investigation exception, directed a compensation arrangement, and recorded Saurav Das withdrawing a September 5 march.

events.title: Report questions 25 facial-recognition identifications
events.summary: Indian Express reviewed 205 serious-charge matches on Delhi Police's list and reported at least 25 people had been incarcerated when their faces were allegedly matched at the demonstration. Not an independently reproduced full-system audit.

events.title: Police clarify which official was suspended over student bond notice
events.summary: UP DGP office said a sub-inspector was suspended over a CJP-protest notice; it said the executive magistrate who signed the Rs 5 lakh notice was not. Court submissions initially prompted confusion.

events.title: School Theek Karo audit begins in Noida
events.summary: Saurav Das and campaign volunteers visited government schools; an allegation that authorities ordered schools closed was rejected by the district education department.

events.title: 48-hour ultimatum over Chief Election Commissioner
events.summary: CJP demanded Gyanesh Kumar resign within 48 hours, saying it would launch further protests; the Election Commission denied bias and wrongdoing.

events.title: Student challenges account of action taken over bond notice
events.summary: Legal reporting describes Tripathi's application alleging the government misstated who was suspended. The court's subsequent adjudication and the original suspension record remain outstanding.

events.title: Electoral-roll campaign intensifies
events.summary: Reuters reported CJP demonstrations demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar resign over contested electoral-roll revisions.

events.title: Multiple groups join Delhi demonstrations
events.summary: Indian Express documented activists and political figures participating in demonstrations against the Election Commission.

events.title: Students travelling to Delhi detained
events.summary: At least 14 students travelling for the October 10 demonstration were detained, according to Indian Express reporting.

events.title: Leaders detained on arrival for Jantar Mantar demonstration
events.summary: Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were detained after landing in Delhi amid a policing operation.

events.title: Goa protesters detained
events.summary: Seven people were detained around Azad Maidan and later ordered released by the Goa bench of the Bombay High Court.

events.title: Jantar Mantar entry leads to fresh detentions
events.summary: Reported 14 movement members entered the restricted site and were detained. Police alleged advance scouting.

events.title: US-donor accusation and rebuttal
events.summary: Mary Millben alleged US funding, while Dipke challenged foreign interference in Indian politics. No transaction record included.

events.title: Amnesty urges release of detained CJP organisers
events.summary: The organisation publicly called for release of Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka. Its position is an advocacy assessment, not a court judgment.

events.title: Joint public press conference
events.summary: CJP and AISA speakers appeared together and called for the October 16 flag-hoisting programme.

events.title: Fact-check challenges circulating Dipke bail-bond image
events.summary: Alt News reported documentary inconsistencies and disputed a viral claim that a peace bond barred any lawful protest for one year. The research desk has not independently authenticated the image or certified bond.

events.title: Lehra Do Tiranga rally and detentions
events.summary: Reuters reported police detentions at Connaught Place; accounts of attendance and legal justification differ.

events.title: University denies permission for proposed CJP campus protest
events.summary: Savitribai Phule Pune University reportedly refused on-campus permission, invoking an August policy for non-university demonstrations. The group moved its October 17 event to the Collector's Office.

events.title: Peaceful Pune rally reported
events.summary: Local organisers raised flags and renewed calls for civil rights, detainees' release and opposition to the SIR process.

events.title: Anti-SIR Town Hall gathering dispersed
events.summary: Indian Express reported roughly 50 activists detained after police cited a designated-site restriction.

events.title: Founder Dipke released after October 16 detention
events.summary: Bar & Bench and Reuters reported that a Special Executive Magistrate ordered Abhijeet Dipke's release. Full signed conditions were not reviewed; this is a separate detention from the Das and Ranka case.

events.title: Police describe FIRs and disputed protest videos
events.summary: Police reportedly registered cases involving prohibited gatherings and alleged fabricated clips; underlying media not forensically reviewed.

events.title: CJP alleges surety rejection and delay in Das-Ranka release
events.summary: CJP legal head Ratna Singh said a scheduled hearing was delayed and four sureties were rejected on unclear grounds. The underlying surety rulings and subsequent release status remain unverified.

events.title: Police report alleged threat to magistrate during proceedings
events.summary: PTI reported a police non-cognisable report against unidentified people following an alleged threat. Neither the message's provenance nor the identity of any sender was established.

events.title: FIR reported over alleged communal slogans
events.summary: Indian Express reported an FIR against unidentified persons under BNS provisions; the alleged conduct is not adjudicated.
